review.tagline: Microsoft's open speech models for long-form ASR and streaming TTS
review.summary: VibeVoice is a family of speech models built on 7.5 Hz continuous tokenizers and next-token diffusion. The ASR models transcribe up to 60 minutes of audio in one pass with speaker, timestamp and hotword support, plus a streaming variant and a CPU build. The TTS side includes a 0.5B real-time model with about 300 ms first-audio latency. The 1.5B long-form TTS code was removed from the repository after misuse.
review.audience: Engineers needing local long-form transcription or streaming TTS
strengths: ASR handles 60 minutes in one pass, returning speaker, timestamps and text together
Streaming ASR, vLLM serving and ASR fine-tuning code are documented
BitNet CPU build shrinks ASR from 4.62 GB to 1.58 GB, RTF under 1 on 3+ threads
Realtime TTS is 0.5B with about 300 ms first audible latency and streaming text input
weaknesses: VibeVoice-TTS code was removed; the 1.5B TTS model is listed as Disabled
README says it is for research only, not recommended for commercial use
Realtime TTS long-form output is about 10 minutes
README gives no RAM or VRAM requirements for the full models
needs: Needs Hugging Face model weights, vLLM (optional, for serving)
Models: VibeVoice-ASR-7B, VibeVoice-ASR-Streaming, VibeVoice-ASR-BitNet, VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B, VibeVoice-TTS-1.5B
